title: SIM-UT: A User Simulation based Evaluation Framework for Medical Triage Chatbots
abstract: arXiv:2610.30412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based chat agents are increasingly used for complex, multi-turn, multilingual medical triage in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet evaluation methods focus on single-turn, English-only benchmarks that primarily test the chatbots' knowledge. In practice, users are often confused, overwhelmed, or emotionally vulnerable, giving unclear, misspelled single-word answers or long messages in regional dialects, and the context of a conversation can shift rapidly. We propose SIM-UT (Simulation of User Behaviour for Triage), a multi-turn, simulation-based evaluation method that identifies ecologically valid, contextually relevant failure modes of LLM-based triage chat agents. Using SIM-UT, we evaluated three real-world WhatsApp-based health chatbots: a respiratory screening programme in India, a hearing health support programme in South Africa, and a diabetes and lifestyle coaching agent in Kenya. translated_title: SIM-UT：一种基于用户模拟的医疗分诊聊天机器人评估框架
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的聊天智能体越来越多地被用于中低收入国家（LMICs）中复杂的、多轮的、多语言的医疗分诊，然而现有的评估方法主要集中于单轮、仅限英语的基准测试，这些测试主要考察聊天机器人的知识水平。在实际应用中，用户常常感到困惑、不知所措或情绪脆弱，会给出不清晰的、拼写错误的单词式回答，或用地方方言发送长篇消息，且对话的上下文可能迅速变化。我们提出了SIM-UT（面向分诊的用户行为模拟），这是一种多轮的、基于模拟的评估方法，能够识别基于LLM的分诊聊天智能体在生态学上有效、符合真实情境的失效模式。利用SIM-UT，我们评估了三个基于WhatsApp的真实健康聊天机器人：印度的呼吸系统筛查项目、南非的听力健康支持项目，以及肯尼亚的糖尿病与生活方式辅导智能体。我们比较了经过医学微调的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SIM-UT，一种多轮用户模拟评估方法，能发现基于LLM的医疗分诊聊天机器人在真实多轮、多语言用户交互情境下的失效模式，并在印度、南非和肯尼亚的三个真实WhatsApp健康聊天机器人上进行了验证。
